Opportunity

At Maersk, we have a vision larger than the ocean: to be a true integrator of container logistics connecting and simplifying our customers’ supply chain. We count on our people to make it happen.

Besides focusing on creating value for our customers and the business, a key priority for us is to drive personal and professional development for our people to prepare for further career progression.

We value the diversity of our talent and will always strive to recruit the best person for the job.

We are now looking for our new Regional Head Europe- People Operations to join our Global Operations Team (GOT) - People Advisory Services

As a Regional Head Europe- People Operations, you will hold regional responsibility for delivering professional, high-quality and integrated HR support across diverse employee groups and cultures. You will lead the regional People Advisory Services team, strengthen employee experience, translate the global HR service delivery model into effective regional execution, and drive continuous improvement through strong stakeholder partnership, disciplined service management and capability building.

What We Offer

We offer you an exciting global career at the forefront of world trade. And thanks to our global scale, you will be well-positioned to explore opportunities at Maersk around the world. The many other highlights include the most modern talent development initiatives and competitive benefits. We are proud of our people who define our company’s industry leadership, global team culture and customer-centric focus every day.

Key Responsibilities

• Consistently drive and deliver high-quality, integrated HR services across the region to strengthen employee experience.

• Provide leadership to the regional People Advisory Services team, creating an environment where colleagues are engaged, proud of their work and connected to a clear sense of purpose.

• Ensure implementation and ongoing effectiveness of the regional People Advisory Services structure in line with agreed timelines and resource plans.

• Translate the global HR service delivery model into a regional, brand-agnostic implementation and resource plan.

• Review the impact of changes in global processes and new Centre of Expertise initiatives, and implement required regional changes in close collaboration with relevant delivery leaders.

• Build strong partnerships with internal and external stakeholders to drive aligned employee experience and continuous improvement.

• Promote best-practice sharing and contribute to the development of service performance measures with global peers.

• Continually review regional service delivery processes, capabilities and resource levels in line with business demand, operating-model maturity and technology adoption.

We’re looking for

• 12-15 years of experience creating and delivering a range of high-quality business services, preferably including HR services.

• HR generalist background in a large international organisation, including HR operations experience; shared-services experience is a strong advantage.

• Demonstrated leadership capability with a strong focus on team engagement, capability building and change.

• Excellent stakeholder management skills and executive presence with business leaders and senior stakeholders.

• Strong employee-experience and customer-service orientation.

• Process and continuous-improvement mindset, with a focus on high-quality and efficient service delivery.

• Ability to translate global operating models into practical regional plans and execution.

• Collaborative working style that fosters cooperation and teamwork across functions, brands and locations.

• High accountability, pace and attention to delivery commitments.

#LI-UK1

Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements.

We are happy to support your need for any adjustments during the application and hiring process. If you need special assistance or an accommodation to use our website, apply for a position, or to perform a job, please contact us by emailing accommodationrequests@maersk.com.

**Your impact begins here

**We are seeking a talented and motivated colleague to join our Biophysics and Injectable Formulation team. In this role, you will collaborate across disciplines to accelerate research and help design the next generation of pharmaceuticals that meet unmet patient needs.

As Senior Research Scientist, you will use biophysics to help decide which drug molecules move forward and how they become stable injectable treatments. You will design experiments, recommend molecule designs and drive formulation development towards clinical development. Working with colleagues across biology, chemistry and recombinant technologies, you will bring automation, high-throughput screening and AI into daily research, helping design the next generation of treatments for unmet patient needs. Your work helps us respond to complex, cross-regional needs with clarity and pace, so Novo can move closer to its purpose of driving change for lasting health.

**What You’ll Bring

**A PhD in biochemistry, biophysics or a related field, preferably combined with at least two years of additional relevant experience and strong expertise in biomolecular science.

• Strong collaboration and networking skills, with demonstrated ability to contribute in matrix project teams.

• Excellent analytical skills and the ability to independently draw and communicate clear conclusions from complex data.

• Excellent written and spoken English, strong communication skills and a team-first approach to solving complex challenges.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**

• Laboratory experience with assay development in high-throughput formats and automation.

• Experience with protein engineering and/or formulation development.

• Experience with NMR spectroscopy for characterisation of proteins and peptides.

**What You’ll Do

**You will apply biophysical characterisation to find fit-for-purpose drug molecules and develop stable injectable formulations, across peptides, proteins, monoclonal antibodies and multi-specific formats. You will have a high level of independence and flexibility within the research project framework.

• Design biophysical characterisation and screening experiments that meet project needs, and recommend molecule design and modality choices for optimal developability in the discovery phase.

• Drive formulation development to enable progression towards clinical development.

• Use state-of-the-art techniques such as light scattering, chromatography, SAXS, nanoDSF, FIDA and NMR to assess drug-product risks in research projects.

• Drive the implementation of new technologies and ways of working in the department.

• Apply automation and high-throughput screening to enable efficient characterisation and selection of molecules with optimal developability profiles.

• Explore and apply digitalisation and AI approaches that bridge experimental science and digital tools to address research project needs.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join Biophysics and Injectable Formulation, a research area of three departments that share biophysical characterisation of biomolecules and injectable formulation development as core tasks. We are part of the Drug Product Research unit, which is responsible for early injectable and oral formulation development and drug product analyses across the Novo research portfolio. The area houses a broad portfolio of state-of-the-art biophysical instrumentation and automation.

Day to day, you will work alongside scientist and laboratory technician colleagues, sharing ideas across scientific specialisations. You will collaborate closely with colleagues in biology, chemistry and recombinant technologies at Novo, as well as selected external industry and academic partners. Together, you will turn data into clear recommendations that help projects move forward.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will have the trust and autonomy to drive change, within a collaborative culture where your contribution matters. You will work with advanced instrumentation and automation, learn from colleagues across disciplines, and help shape how the department adopts new technologies, digital tools and AI. You will be supported to perform at your best, while being encouraged to make your voice heard and grow with the team.

**Salary

**For this role, the annual base salary ranges from 651.000 to 956.900 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area, and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn biophysical insight into progress for people living with serious chronic diseases, apply for the Senior Research Scientist role by 13th November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

We're looking for a Customer Success Manager to lead complex enterprise implementations in a fast-moving company on a mission to help businesses fight financial crime and simplify compliance.

This role combines project leadership, technical problem-solving, and hands-on work with customer data. You'll get a front-row seat to how large organizations run KYC and compliance - and you'll be the one who makes it painless for them. Customer pain is our pain, and your goal is to turn their messy real-world problems into a smooth, structured onboarding experience.

You don't need to be an engineer, but you should be comfortable acting as an owner of the data workstream in onboarding and collaborating closely on integration-dependent deliveries.

You'll own implementations end-to-end for a portfolio of customers: project plans, stakeholder alignment, data mapping, validation, troubleshooting, and clear communication throughout delivery.

You'll work closely with peers in Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and Support, especially when delivery depends on integrations, APIs, or data workflows.

We're open to strong mid-level and senior candidates.

After go-live, you'll stay close enough to support adoption and a smooth handover into the broader customer lifecycle.

**Example projects you might run

**

• Enterprise onboarding: Managing multiple stakeholders (Compliance, IT, business owners) against a fixed go-live date.

• Data intake and migration: Mapping customer data into Avallone templates, validating outcomes, and troubleshooting edge cases.

• Integration-dependent delivery: Aligning requirements, timelines, and technical dependencies across teams.

• Most weeks you'll have multiple onboardings or delivery workstreams running in parallel, so executing with urgency, communicating clearly, and keeping momentum is key.

**Roles + Responsibilities

**

• Act as an owner for onboarding and implementation for your customer portfolio: build project plans, coordinate stakeholders, and drive execution against timelines.

• Lead the technical workstream: handle data intake, mapping, validation, troubleshooting, and iterative improvement of datasets.

• Turn customer processes into concrete steps: capture requirements, map processes, and build clear action plans.

• Run customer-facing communication: provide status updates, manage risk, and set expectations with everyone from compliance specialists to executives.

• Drive cross-functional success: work with Product and Engineering when delivery involves integrations/APIs; surface issues early, help drive them to closure, and feed insights back into the product roadmap.

• Support post-go-live motions: conduct adoption check-ins and health checks, and contribute to QBR preparation.

• Notice early when a customer is drifting, put a plan on the table, and drive it.

• Flag when a customer is ready for more (more users, workflows, or products) and bring the context to Sales.

• Share what you learn so the team gets faster over time (checklists, templates, SOPs, playbook improvements).

**What Success Looks Like (first 6 Months)

**

• You've delivered multiple onboardings to a predictable go-live without surprises in the final stretch.

• Customers trust the output: uploads are validated, issues are documented clearly, and fixes happen fast.

• You've helped customers reach meaningful early value (Activation) and built momentum towards steady, everyday use.

• You've improved at least one repeatable artifact (template/checklist/SOP) based on patterns you've seen in real implementations.

**Requirements

**We'll hire at the level that matches your experience.

**Core Requirements

**

• Experience in Customer Success, onboarding/implementation, project management, or a similar customer-facing role in a SaaS environment.

• Strong project management skills: you can create structure, align people, and keep delivery moving.

• Technical aptitude and comfort working hands-on with customer data (not just coordinating): CSVs/templates, mapping, validation checks, troubleshooting, and attention to detail.

• Professional proficiency in both written and verbal communication in English.

• Strong ownership and follow-through.

**What tends to make people successful in this role

**

• You like turning messy, real-world problems into a clear plan and getting it done.

• You communicate early when something is off track.

• You know when "good enough to ship" is the right call, and you document what you did.

**Leveling guidance

**

• Mid-level: you can run well-scoped onboardings, execute established workflows, and escalate early when needed.

• Senior: you lead the toughest implementations, handle ambiguity, coach others through tricky technical/data cases, and drive cross-functional execution.

**Bonus points

**

• Strong proficiency in Danish is a big plus.

• API-enabled implementations and/or data integrations.

• Experience in compliance-heavy domains (KYC/AML, sanctions, risk, or similar).

• Comfortable using simple tooling to validate/troubleshoot data (e.g., basic SQL, Excel/Sheets checks, BI).

**Why Avallone?

**At Avallone, implementations matter commercially, operationally, and for customer trust. You'll work on real delivery problems with smart colleagues across Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and Support.

You'll help shape how we run onboardings as we scale, and you'll join a company that values a true people-first culture. We care about our customers, our values, and each other.

We focus on your passion and desire to grow, and we believe that when we win big, we celebrate big. You'll collaborate, learn, and grow with some of the smartest people in the industry - and you will have a lot of fun doing it!

**Location

**Copenhagen, Denmark – hybrid (primarily office-based)

**How To Apply

**We hire on a rolling basis and will close the process once we've found the right person. If this sounds like you, don't wait, send us your application.

_Are you excited about working with data and business performance, and motivated to continuously improve how things are done?

_Pandora is currently looking for a Student Assistant to join our Investment Governance & Performance team within Global Network Development & Insights. In this role, you will support the governance and performance tracking of investments across Pandora's global store network. You will work closely with the Franchise & Network Management team as well as local property teams, helping ensure that investment decisions are financially sound, strategically aligned, and supported by data-driven insights.

This is a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience with investment analysis, retail network strategy, and business performance management in one of the world's leading jewellery brands. Working closely with stakeholders across Pandora's global organization, you will gain exposure to how strategic decisions regarding store openings, relocations, lease renewals, and closures are evaluated, approved, and measured.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Contribute to optimization and automation of investment governance processes.

• Provide analysis and insights to support and improve future network investment decisions.

• Maintain and update the global investment overview and support ongoing investment governance activities.

• Upload and track Investment Proposals (IPs) and support hindsight reporting to evaluate business case performance against actual results.

• Support ongoing store classification processes and ad hoc business requests.

**Your Team

**The Global Network Development & Insights function partners with the Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) organization to provide strategic insights that shape Pandora's global retail and franchise network. The team collaborates closely with Cluster Property Directors and commercial stakeholders worldwide to drive performance, support investment decisions, and execute global growth priorities.

You will report to the Network Expansion & Investments Senior Manager and become part of a collaborative, international team focused on data-driven decision-making and strategic investment optimization.

**Qualifications

**

• Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree within Business Administration, Finance, Data Analytics, IT, or a related field.

• Ideally have around two years remaining of your studies.

• Proficient in Microsoft Excel and comfortable working with large datasets.

• Strong English communication skills, both written and spoken.

• Experience with Power BI, Power Query, Power Automate, AI, or other data and automation tools is considered an advantage.

• Interest in using data and technology to solve business challenges.

**Personal Competencies

**

• Analytical, curious, and motivated by solving complex business challenges.

• Structured, detail-oriented, and highly organized in your way of working.

• Proactive and able to take ownership of tasks while working independently.

• Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

• Collaborative and confident working with stakeholders across different functions and markets.

• Strong communication skills and a continuous improvement mindset.

• Eager to learn and develop both technical and commercial capabilities.

**What We Offer

**A position as a Student Assistant at Pandora offers you an opportunity for both personal and professional development in a global organization. This is your chance to join the world's largest jewellery brand and gain valuable experience within investment governance, business performance, and retail network strategy while working alongside talented and passionate colleagues.

**You Will Get

**

• Hands-on experience with investment analysis and decision-making in a global retail business.

• Exposure to senior stakeholders across Commercial, Finance, and Network Development.

• Insight into how data and business cases drive store investment and network decisions.

• Support and coaching from your manager and experienced team members.

• The opportunity to build analytical, commercial, and stakeholder management skills that will benefit your future career.

**Additional Information

**

• You are expected to work approximately 15-20 hours per week on average (less during exam periods and more when possible).

• The role is based at Pandora's Global Office in Copenhagen and requires physical presence.

• You must be a current student to apply.

• Start date: As soon as possible.

**Did We Get Your Attention?

**We hope you got all your questions answered and feel confident applying for this position. If you would like to become part of Pandora's future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site at Pandora Group.

**Icing on the Cake

**You will be working out of our beautiful Head Office in Copenhagen V, established in 2016 and designed to unite and inspire our teams. Besides our beautiful interior design we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable and inspirational – and delivers a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world’s largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores. Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

At Genmab, we’re committed to building extra[not]ordinary futures together, by developing antibody products and pioneering, knock-your-socks-off therapies that change the lives of patients and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. From our people who are caring, candid, and impact-driven to our business, which is innovative and rooted in science, we believe that being proudly unique, determined to be our best, and authentic is essential to fulfilling our purpose.

**The Role and Department

**The Late Stage CMC Project organization is growing and we are looking for 2 Directors to lead and develop a team of Project Managers in Genmab’s late-stage CMC project organization.

The roles have similar responsibility and you will combine people leadership with strategic oversight and hands-on responsibility for complex CMC programs, including contribution to governance of outsourced activities with contract development and manufacturing organizations (CDMOs).

Both postions report to the Senior Director, Head of the Late-Stage Project Management Office, within Genmab Tech Ops in Denmark. Working closely with CMC, Regulatory Affairs, Quality and Supply Chain, you will align CMC delivery with development priorities and drive progress towards regulatory submission and commercial readiness.

You will help shape the late-stage project organization, develop experienced Project Managers and translate portfolio priorities into clear decisions and reliable delivery.

**Responsibilities

**Team leadership and development

• Lead and develop your team through resource planning, recruitment, performance management and succession planning, building capabilities for current and future portfolio needs

• Coach Project Managers in strategic thinking, cross-functional leadership and resolving complex CMC challenges. Set clear expectations, delegate effectively and build accountability for results

• Work closely with the Senior Director to prioritize resources and budgets across the team’s programs, resolve capacity constraints and align delivery with portfolio objectives

CMC strategy and project responsibilities

• Shape CMC strategies with technical and functional leads, aligned with overall Drug Development Plans. Lead assigned programs through integrated planning, budget analysis and management of cross-program dependencies.

• Drive cross-functional delivery of technology transfer, process validation, manufacturing readiness and submission documentation, with clear ownership and adherence to Genmab’s quality system and applicable regulatory requirements

• Ensure reliable plans, risk and decision logs, and executive reporting. Anticipate portfolio impacts, resolve high-impact issues and facilitate data-driven options and recommendations to senior governance forums

• Lead improvements to the Project Manual, governance and ways of working, including digital and AI-enabled tools that strengthen planning, risk management and delivery

**CDMO collaboration and project governance

**

• Representing Late Stage CMC Project Management in CDMO joint project and steering committees, facilitating strategic discussions and decisions within delegated authority. Ensure decisions translate into clear commitments and follow-through

• Shape outsourcing and partnership strategies with relevant functions, aligning proposals, contracts and quality agreements with program objectives, business needs and intellectual property considerations

• Hold partners accountable for agreed scope, quality, timelines and budgets. Build transparent relationships, resolve vendor conflicts and escalate strategic trade-offs and risks with clear recommendations

**Requirements

**

• Master’s degree or higher in natural sciences, pharmacy, engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent experience

• Extensive biopharmaceutical CMC experience, including late-stage biologics development and progression towards commercial supply. Experience with antibody-drug conjugates is an advantage

• Proven experience shaping strategies and leading complex global CMC programs, including portfolio prioritization, strategic budget management and cross-functional risk resolution

• Established people-leadership experience, with a track record of developing Project Managers, building team capabilities and supporting talent and succession planning

• Strong understanding of technology transfer, process validation, submission strategies and the interdependencies between development, manufacturing and supply

• Experience shaping outsourcing strategies, leading CDMO governance and resolving complex partner issues with sound business judgment

• Advanced knowledge of GMP and global CMC regulatory expectations, including those relevant to FDA, EMA and NMPA submissions

• Excellent English communication skills, with a track record of influencing senior stakeholders and translating complex issues into clear business recommendations.

**About You

**You combine strategic perspective with the judgment to know when to engage directly and when to empower others. You develop people, set clear priorities and make well-founded decisions under uncertainty, balancing quality, timelines and cost.

You build trust across functions and cultures, challenge assumptions constructively and create an inclusive environment where colleagues take ownership. You champion a ONE-Team approach, welcome feedback and turn lessons learned into improvements across the project organization.

**Location and Travel

**The role is based in Denmark. Travel is expected to be approximately 10–15 days per year.

Genmab leverages the effectiveness of an agile working environment, when possible, for the betterment of employee work-life balance. Our offices are designed as open, community-based spaces that work to connect our employees. Whether you’re in one of our collaboratively designed office spaces or working remotely, we thrive on connecting with each other to innovate.

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK883.200,00---1.324.800,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

**The Impact You'll Make

**Join Danfoss Power Solutions as our new Controller, Procurement Controlling!

Being part of our Finance division, you will help shape how procurement performance is measured, understood, and improved across Danfoss Power Solutions. Your work will provide the insights that procurement leaders use to make decisions, track savings, and connect procurement activities with business results. Working in a truly global environment, you will collaborate with stakeholders from operational teams through to senior leadership, turning large and complex datasets into clear recommendations and meaningful actions.

This role offers a unique combination of analytics, business partnering, and exposure to strategic growth initiatives, including integration and transformation projects across the organization. You can be based at one of our Danfoss Power Solutions locations in Europe, the US or Mexico.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Enable better business decisions by delivering procurement performance reporting, insights, and analysis that support procurement leadership and key stakeholders globally.

• Increase transparency of procurement results by aligning savings and key performance indicators across procurement, finance, and business teams.

• Transform complex data into actionable recommendations by developing and maintaining Power BI dashboards, reporting tools, and data models using multiple data sources.

• Support monthly business performance reviews by preparing reporting packages, forecasts, and management overviews within a fast-paced reporting cycle.

• Build engagement across the organization by acting as a trusted partner, delivering guidance, training, and expertise on procurement performance data and reporting processes.

**What We're Looking For

**

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Finance, Controlling, Data Analytics, or a related field.

• At least 3 years of experience in data analytics, controlling, performance management, or a similar analytical business role.

• Hands-on experience with Power BI, Power Query, DAX, advanced Excel, and working with large datasets from multiple sources.

• Ability to communicate confidently with stakeholders at all levels, from operational teams to senior leadership, and build relationships across regions and functions.

• Fluent written and spoken English and a proactive approach to solving problems, asking questions, and driving improvements.

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about. We think they’re pretty great.

• You’ll gain broad exposure to procurement, finance, and business leaders across Danfoss, providing insight into how global procurement influences company performance.

• You’ll work with modern analytics tools and large-scale datasets, helping shape the future of procurement reporting and performance management.

• You’ll be part of a small, collaborative controlling team where your contributions are visible and your ideas can directly influence processes and reporting practices.

• You’ll have opportunities to contribute to high-impact business initiatives, including integration and growth projects within a rapidly evolving global organization.

• You’ll build an international network and develop experience working across cultures, regions, and functions in a global business environment.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If you enjoy turning data into business insights, building relationships across a global organization, and helping leaders make better decisions, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

Do you enjoy turning business requirements and market insights into sourcing opportunities that create value for the organization? Join Ambu’s Global Indirect Procurement & Capex team and play an important role in supporting procurement across an international, fast-growing organization.

As Associate Category Manager, you will support sourcing and category management activities across indirect Procurement. Working closely with experienced Global Category Managers, you will lead or contribute to sourcing projects, supplier management activities, market analyses and stakeholder engagement while developing your sourcing & category management capabilities. You will gradually take ownership of defined sourcing activities and projects while building experience across the source-to-contract process.

You will join an ambitious global procurement organization where your work will have visible business impact. The role offers broad exposure to international stakeholders, varied indirect categories and end-to-end sourcing activities, providing a unique opportunity to build experience across a global procurement environment.

The position is based at Ambu’s headquarters in Ballerup and reports to the Director of Global Indirect Procurement & Capex.

**Key Responsibilities

**Your main responsibilities will include:

• Support the translation of business requirements and market insights into sourcing strategies and recommendations.

• Contribute to or lead RFI, RFQ and RFP processes, including supplier identification, market analysis, preparation of sourcing documentation, proposal evaluation and stakeholder coordination.

• Independently manage defined sourcing activities and less complex sourcing events using established procurement processes and tools.

• Support supplier negotiations, contract preparation and contract handover activities.

• Analyze spend, suppliers, markets and cost drivers to identify savings opportunities, value creation initiatives and risk considerations.

• Prepare sourcing analyses, recommendations and business case inputs for stakeholder decision-making.

• Build productive relationships with stakeholders, suppliers and cross-functional partners, collaborating closely with Global Category Managers and function including Legal, Quality Assurance, Finance and IT.

• Support continuous improvement initiatives, digital procurement activities and the adoption of new procurement tools and processes.

**Suggested candidate profile

****Skills

**Skills and experiences can be earned in many different ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be prescribed on paper. You are however likely to succeed in this position if you:

• Hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree within Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Economics, Finance or a related field.

• Bring 2-3 years of experience within procurement, sourcing, category management or a related procurement function.

• Have experience supporting sourcing initiatives, supplier management activities or procurement projects.

• Understand source-to-contract processes and are comfortable working with stakeholders across different functions.

• Possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn data and market insights into recommendations.

• Are a structured and proactive team player with strong communication and project coordination skills, including solid Excel and Microsoft Office capabilities.

• Communicate fluently in English and are motivated to learn and grow within a global procurement organization. Experience with sourcing platforms (e.g. Keelvar, Coupa, Ariba, GEP or similar) as well as an interest in digital procurement, AI or process automation is considered an advantage.

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**

**Ambu A/S is currently looking for a Global Business Owner, Global Procurement to be based in Ballerup, Denmark

In this role, you will lead Global Procurement through our global ERP, QMS and PLM transformation, turning functional strategy into harmonized processes, clear decisions and measurable value. You will report to the Global Operations Program Director, with functional anchoring to the VP Global Procurement, and work closely with Global Process Owners, site leadership, IT, Finance, Quality and implementation partners.

This is a unique opportunity to shape a major global transformation and challenge established ways of working. It will suit an experienced procurement leader who enjoys bridging business and technology and driving change at scale.

**Key Responsibilities

**Your main responsibilities will include:

• Developing the transformation roadmap, target operating model and benefit case for Global Procurement

• Representing Global Procurement in program governance and making timely decisions

• Driving simplification, harmonization and adoption across sites

• Ensuring processes, data and systems meet quality and regulatory requirements

**Suggested candidate profile

****Skills

**Skills and experiences can be earned in many different ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be prescribed on paper. You are however likely to succeed in this position if you:

• Have leadership experience within Global Procurement

• Hold a degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Business or a related field, or equivalent experience

• Have strong knowledge of global operations and end-to-end processes

• Come from medical devices, life sciences, pharmaceuticals or another regulated industry

• Have delivered major business transformation or enterprise system implementations

• Have strong executive presence and can influence across functions and sites

• Have ERP, QMS or PLM experience (ideally Infor M3 or Dassault Systèmes) and are flexible to travel internationally

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

**Technical Services Manager – VELUX Skjern

****Are you an experienced technical leader who thrives on combining strategic direction with operational excellence? Join our production site in Skjern and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of advanced manufacturing, driving technical performance, digitalisation, and continuous improvement across a highly automated production environment.

****Meet your future team

**As Technical Manager, you will be based in Skjern and report directly to the General Manager. You will lead a diverse and highly skilled Technical Services organisation consisting of Project Engineers, Engineering Specialists within mechanical and electronic engineering and analytics, and a Maintenance team of experienced technicians. Together, the team plays a crucial role in ensuring equipment reliability, delivering technical projects, and supporting production excellence.

You will become part of both local and international leadership forums, collaborating closely with colleagues across Operations, Engineering, Quality and Production. The role offers significant influence and autonomy, enabling you to identify opportunities, drive improvements and contribute to the continued development of a mature Lean culture built on VELUX values.

A key focus in the coming years will be the optimisation of a highly automated production facility in Skjern, which will serve as a blueprint for future implementation at one of our production sites in France.

**What We Offer

**In this role, you will lead technical operations across the site while supporting the organisation's strategic ambitions around operational performance, innovation and manufacturing excellence. You will have the opportunity to influence both people and processes, ensuring that technical capabilities continue to evolve in line with business needs.

More specifically, your tasks will be to:

• Lead and develop the Technical Services organisation through values-based leadership, fostering a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, safety and technical excellence.

• Ensure high levels of equipment availability, reliability and performance across production operations.

• Develop and strengthen team capabilities within engineering, technical project management, maintenance and digitalisation.

• Drive equipment stability, process optimisation and digital transformation initiatives while delivering against operational KPIs and global standards.

• Identify, evaluate and implement innovative technologies, systems and working methods that enhance productivity, quality and efficiency.

• Support the installation, integration and optimisation of new machinery and production technologies across the site.

• Collaborate with local and international stakeholders to deliver strategic projects and share best practices across the organisation.

**What You Will Bring

**You are an experienced people leader who enjoys developing teams and creating an environment where individuals can perform at their best. You combine technical expertise with strong business understanding and are equally comfortable defining strategic priorities and ensuring successful execution.

Moreover, we expect that you:

• Bring proven leadership experience from a manufacturing or industrial environment, preferably within a larger international organisation.

• Hold a relevant technical qualification such as Engineering, Production Technology, Marine Engineering or a comparable discipline.

• Have substantial experience leading technical, engineering, maintenance or project teams.

• Possess a strong understanding of Lean principles, operational excellence and continuous improvement methodologies.

• Have experience driving technical development, automation, digitalisation or production improvement initiatives.

• Communicate effectively across all organisational levels and build strong relationships based on trust, collaboration and mutual respect.

• Are fluent in English and Danish, both written and spoken.

**Ready to apply?

**Learn more about the VELUX Group online at www.velux.com where you can read more about working at our company and what to expect of our recruitment process.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis until we have the right match. All enquiries will be treated confidentially.

**About VELUX

**In the VELUX Group, we offer you a world of opportunities and the chance to create a bright future. From the forefront of the roof window category, we enable those who live, work and play under the roof transform their spaces and live a healthier everyday life with more daylight and fresh air.

The VELUX Group is an international, family-owned business with strong financial roots and each year we can create real impact by reinvesting in society, our employees and planet through our foundations. With 20 production companies in 12 countries and sales companies in 37 countries, our products are widely available. We employ around 12,000 people, and our company is headquartered in Denmark. Alongside the rest of our values, courage and mutual respect define our actions every day and how we wish to contribute to the world.

**Equal Opportunity Employer

**At VELUX Residential, we believe in fostering a diverse workplace for everyone to thrive, develop and perform at their best, and where you feel welcome, respected and valued. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all, whether you are applying for a role or already a part of VELUX Residential. That means we recruit, hire, train and promote people based on their skills and potential without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, age, neurodiversity, disability, protected veteran status, national origin, sexual orientation or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

We value diversity and strive to ensure that our employment decisions are fair and inclusive, focusing only on what truly matters: your qualifications and how you can contribute to our shared mission and success.

Content Specialist - PR & Journalism

Do you have a background in journalism or PR? Then you already have a head start. At Bonzer, your sense for a good story, sharp angles and solid research is exactly what makes content stand out – on Google, in the media and in the answers AI models give.

We're looking for someone who wants to be among the best content people in Scandinavia – and who sees every piece as a chance to get sharper.

About us

Bonzer is a specialised SEO agency passionate about helping businesses strengthen their online presence and visibility across Google and AI search platforms such as ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini. That’s why we focus on crafting strong, organic strategies and SEO results tailored to our clients’ needs, goals and ambitions.

At Bonzer, we support our clients’ overall business and marketing strategy through in-depth analyses, strategic roadmaps and effective SEO sprints. We value close, honest and transparent relationships, both externally with our clients and internally with each other.

The role

As our new Content Specialist, you'll join a content team we're actively building and strengthening. You'll produce high-quality content for Bonzer's clients – content built to rank at the top of Google, earn coverage in the media and be visible in AI search platforms and language models.

Search is changing rapidly. More and more people find answers, products and brands through AI models. That's why journalism and PR skills are more valuable in SEO than ever. You'll work hands-on with this shift every day, helping our clients grow through organic visibility.

We want someone who's naturally drawn to exploring how new AI tools can make their day-to-day sharper. Not because someone tells you to, but because it's genuinely fun to figure out what's suddenly possible.

We don’t expect you to know everything from day one. What we expect is that you bring strong craft, high standards and the drive to keep raising the bar.

Your responsibilities

• You'll create different types of high-quality content for our clients, such as blog posts, product and category texts, press releases, and graphic and interactive formats. Every piece combines strong craftsmanship with a clear strategic purpose.

• You'll drive Digital PR for our clients: find newsworthy angles in data and client insights, pitch stories and land coverage in global media.

• You'll create content that AI models pick up, cite and trust, helping our clients become visible not only on Google but also in the answers AI search platforms give.

• You'll explore how new AI tools can make your day-to-day work sharper – and share what you learn with the team.

• You'll own your tasks from start to finish. You'll keep an overview of multiple tasks and deadlines, take responsibility for the quality of your work and contribute to your team's shared goals.

Who you are

You have experience within journalism, PR, communication, content creation or similar areas.

Above all, you're a genuinely strong writer and know what makes a story newsworthy**.** You know how to create texts that are engaging, well-structured and tailored to different audiences and formats – and you take pride in delivering quality every time, even under deadline pressure.

Experience with SEO isn't a requirement, but we want to see a genuine interest in AI search, visibility in AI models and Digital PR. Just as important, you're curious about AI as a tool, not just as a topic.

You're organised and structured, and you take responsibility for your own performance. That's why we're looking for new colleagues who thrive in a collaborative environment, value community and share our values, so that together we can strengthen each other and the company.

You have high standards for your own work – you seek out feedback, study the best in the field and enjoy improving yourself. We value your character, craftsmanship and teamwork above all.

You'll thrive here if…

• you get a kick out of seeing your story in the media or your text at the top of Google

• you see feedback as the fastest way to grow

• you like a dynamic day where no two days are the same

Language requirements: You must speak and write fluently in Danish and English, and be a resident of Denmark, as the role is based at our Copenhagen office. Excellent Danish skills are essential for creating content for our Danish clients, and English is our primary working language across markets.

What we offer

• Dedicated support from day one

• Mentorship and skill development

• Working with exciting clients and brands

• Rapid development and career opportunities

• Valuable insight into SEO and the latest developments in AI-driven search

• Responsibility and independent tasks from day one

• Close collaboration with experienced and specialised colleagues

• A strong team culture with regular events and activities

• A growing team of 50 specialists across Denmark, Sweden and Norway

• An office in the centre of Copenhagen

How to apply

If you are interested in the role of Content Specialist at Bonzer, please upload your CV.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so don't wait. Expected start: December 2026.

We will get back to you directly if we see a potential match and invite you to a short introductory interview.

The recruitment process consists of the following steps:

• First interview

• Second interview with case

• Final interview

We look forward to receiving your application!

Best regards,

Team Bonzer
